definitions.gloss: ambition, desire to improve oneself, aspiration
definitions.explanation: The inner drive to better oneself, develop skills, or advance in life. A positive character trait involving the motivation to keep growing and not become complacent.

examples.japanese: {向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: People with a desire to improve grow quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}している→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: She has a strong drive to improve and is always taking on new challenges.

examples.japanese: {向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦プライベート→プライベート：11277_puraibeeto⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to keep your desire to improve alive, both at work and in your personal life.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (have ambition/drive)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (have a strong desire to improve)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (have aspirations)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ (lack ambition)

A compound of ⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧ (improvement, advancement) and {心|しん} (mind, spirit). Frequently appears in self-help books, job interviews, and discussions about personal development. Always carries a positive connotation.
